title: Kinds
description: The tree's levels: the kinds part of plat5.yml.

kinds.title: kinds
kinds.description: Map of kind name → kind. Every node in identity is one of these kinds.

kind_name.title: kind name
kind_name.description: Lowercase identifier, `[a-z][a-z0-9_]*`, max 32. Not `public`, `member` or `user`. Names the kind in route scopes, path params, placeholders (`{project.id}`), headers (`X-Plat5-Project-Id`), events (`kind: project`) and audit. Fixed once nodes exist: a rename reads as a remove plus an add.

parent.title: parent
parent.description: The one kind a node sits under. Omitted for a root.

path.title: path
path.description: Required. The kind's piece of every public path: `/<collection>/{<kind name>}`, such as `/projects/{project}`. The collection has the slug shape. Plat5 joins the pieces root first, so a project's routes sit under `/orgs/{organization}/projects/{project}`.

list_permission.title: list_permission
list_permission.description: Required. The permission that shows a node of this kind in a list, live or deleted ([lists](../../concepts/access.md#lists)).
